title: allow env-prefixed go test commands, or give the UI role a renders env var already set

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The ui reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261119-143744-0f7d, project ork, item S348:

allow env-prefixed go test commands, or give the UI role a renders env var already set

Evidence: `S348_RENDERS=... go -C ... test -overlay ...` was denied "This command requires approval"; the same command with the path hardcoded ran
